name: Kazaoka Aira
source: A young female president who founded a travel agency with women her age. She collaborates with the hotel to plan various tours, often making personal appearances. With a sharp, charismatic beauty, she has a workaholic streak that keeps her distant from romance, leaving her surprisingly unaccustomed to being treated as a woman.
